scripts.db:backup: powershell -Command "if (!(Test-Path backups)) { New-Item backups -ItemType Directory } ; Get-ChildItem backups\rentflow_*.backup -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-Item -Force ; $ts = Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd_HHmmss ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_dump -U rentflow -F c -f /tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup rentflow ; docker cp rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow_$ts.backup backups/rentflow_$ts.backup"
scripts.db:restore: powershell -Command "$f = Get-ChildItem backups\rentflow_*.backup | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1 ; docker cp $f.FullName rentflow-postgres:/tmp/rentflow.backup ; docker exec rentflow-postgres pg_restore -U rentflow -d rentflow --clean --if-exists /tmp/rentflow.backup"
scripts.clean:comments: npx jscodeshift -t ./scripts/remove-all-comments.js frontend/app frontend/components frontend/features frontend/lib frontend/hooks frontend/context frontend/middlewares backend/src --extensions=js,jsx,ts,tsx --parser=tsx --run-in-band --ignore-pattern "**/.next/**" --ignore-pattern "**/node_modules/**" --ignore-pattern "**/public/**" --ignore-pattern "**/prisma/**"
scripts.clean:all: npm run clean:comments && prettier --write frontend/app frontend/components frontend/features frontend/lib frontend/hooks frontend/context frontend/middlewares backend/src
